summary: Dependency-confusion beacon exfiltrates host metadata to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: @ecg-internal/js-react-i18n@1.1.0 is a functionally inert npm package whose only effect on install or require is to POST machine metadata to a hardcoded attacker endpoint. The postinstall script beacon.cjs and the main module index.js both call beacon.cjs's fire() routine, which sends the package name, os.hostname(), __dirname (install path), process.cwd(), and process.version to http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc over plain HTTP to a bare IP. index.js exports a Proxy that returns no-op functions for every accessed property, so bundlers resolving @ecg-internal/js-react-i18n complete their build without errors while the beacon fires. The scoped @ecg-internal/* namespace combined with the inert Proxy stub and host-identifying callback is the canonical dependency-confusion shape: a public squat on an internal package name whose purpose is to confirm execution inside a target organization's build environment and surface the hostnames and install paths of internal systems to the operator of 185.158.107.175.
